title: CacheDB
shortDescription: A distributed in-memory key-value store built in Go.
description: A distributed key-value store with concurrent TCP request handling, consistent hashing, replication, failure detection, rebalancing, cache eviction, and durable persistence.
problem: A single-node cache cannot provide reliable distribution, fault tolerance, or durable recovery.
solution: Implemented distributed partitioning, replication, failure detection, automatic key rebalancing, cache management, write-ahead logging, crash recovery, and snapshots.
results: Supports 4+ distributed nodes with automatic request routing.
Includes TTL expiration and LRU eviction.
Provides WAL-based persistence and crash recovery.

title: Atlas
shortDescription: AI-powered traffic intelligence and emergency response platform.
description: An end-to-end traffic intelligence platform using FastAPI, ML predictions, geospatial processing, and context-aware emergency resource allocation.
problem: Traffic incidents require combining live traffic, location context, and predicted severity for effective response.
solution: Built ML pipelines for incident severity and composite-risk prediction, geospatial enrichment, and Gemini-assisted emergency resource allocation.
results: Engineered spatial, temporal, and event-based features.
Integrated live traffic data and geospatial services.

title: TradePaper
shortDescription: A real-time virtual stock trading platform.
description: A paper-trading system with live market data, portfolio management, order execution, asynchronous services, and automated stop-loss monitoring.
problem: A trading simulator needs real-time updates, reliable order processing, and background portfolio operations.
solution: Built REST APIs and asynchronous services for order processing, portfolio management, live updates, and stop-loss monitoring.
